description: Stamp a cryptographic receipt on content. Writes to the APEX PSI append-only ledger with SHA-256 hash, Ed25519 signature, and post-quantum LMS-W4-SHA256 signature. Proves existence and integrity at a point in time — not the truth of the contents.

content.description: The content to seal (text, up to 10000 characters)

context.description: Optional context label (e.g. document name, case ID)

model_id.description: Optional model/agent identifier producing the seal

predicate.description: Optional predicate describing why this is sealed

name: seal
title: Seal content
